reason: the security lens's findings the code or a test must fix

findings.text: security lens, low: The load-time probe array _ZB_SED_INPLACE_ARGS is not declared readonly, so any code in the same shell process that runs after compat.sh is sourced can append or replace its elements, injecting extra sed arguments (e.g. -e or -f flags) into every subsequent zbuild_sed_inplace call. (scripts/lib/compat.sh: "declare -a _ZB_SED_INPLACE_ARGS"; fix: code)

security lens, low: _zb_target_mode_v guards _ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD with ${_ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD:-}, so if the variable is unset or cleared after load (e.g. by a test that sources helpers.sh then runs unset _ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD) the function silently falls through to the BSD stat -f branch on a GNU host, returning mode 600 for every existing file. (scripts/lib/helpers.sh: "if [[ "${_ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD:-}" == "-c" ]]; then"; fix: code)
